references.text: Repeats the counting of the tribe of Simeon with the same number (59,300) when they are organized in the camp.
The second census of the tribe of Simeon shows a dramatic decline to 22,200, illustrating the tribe's reduction over the period of wilderness wandering.
Describes the birth of Simeon and the origin of his name as a son of Jacob and Leah.
Lists the sons of Simeon who went down to Egypt, showing the tribe's origins before the migration.
Jacob's prophecy concerning Simeon, predicting that the tribe will be scattered within Israel.
